history.title: Manual event test · Crisis
history.report:
Bombay invasion: 5 attack against 3 empire defence; successful (ties fail).

Remove Punjab’s allegiance flag: it becomes sovereign after Delhi’s empire breaks.

Remove Maratha’s allegiance flag: it becomes sovereign after Delhi’s empire breaks.

Place Bombay’s flag on Delhi. Bombay is the empire capital; use an available starred flag if this forms a new empire.

Move the Elephant from Bombay facing Maratha.

Manual test: the digital event stack and phase event count are unchanged. Use Undo to reverse this test’s board effects.

elephantMoves.instruction: Move the Elephant from Bombay facing Maratha.

lines.text: Bombay won the attack on Delhi. Punjab became sovereign after Delhi lost its empire. Maratha became sovereign after Delhi lost its empire. Delhi became subordinate to Bombay following the attack.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: Our empire no longer holds Punjab. Earlier authority does not describe our present position.
lines.speaker: Rashid of Delhi

lines.text: The allegiance of Delhi has changed. Our court must now deal with the authority the result gives us.
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay

lines.text: The capital has fallen. Punjab will now conduct its own affairs.
lines.speaker: Rahim of Punjab

lines.text: The capital has fallen. Maratha will now conduct its own affairs.
lines.speaker: Gopal of Maratha

history.title: Manual event test · Leader
history.report:
Delhi rebellion: 1 + -3 = -2 against Bombay’s 5; failed (ties fail). Other empire regions do not contribute.

Bombay: set tower to 4 levels.

Manual test: the digital event stack and phase event count are unchanged. Use Undo to reverse this test’s board effects.

lines.text: The rebellion in Delhi has failed. I shall not mistake that outcome for an end to the dispute.
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay

lines.text: The rebellion has failed. The political position in Delhi remains unchanged.
lines.speaker: Rashid of Delhi

history.title: Manual event test · Leader
history.report:
Delhi rebellion: 1 + 10 = 11 against Bombay’s 4; successful (ties fail). Other empire regions do not contribute.

Remove Delhi’s empire flag: it becomes sovereign.

Close Delhi £5 (northern). Return any writer there to its owner; flip any filled-order token.

Manual test: the digital event stack and phase event count are unchanged. Use Undo to reverse this test’s board effects.

lines.text: The earlier rebellion in Delhi failed. This time the region is independent.
lines.speaker: Rashid of Delhi

lines.text: The rebellion in Delhi has succeeded. We cannot write its independence out of the record.
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay
